messages.subject: GGIR maintenance and user-support
parts:
Dear GGIR users,

If you are interested to help develop and maintain GGIR then please
get in touch. The more people that are actively involved in
maintaining and improving GGIR and in responding to questions from
users the higher the chance that it can be sustained into the future.
We already have had some support from Jairo, Evgeny, Séverine and
Alex, but more help is definitely welcome.

From January onward, you can hire me for my time. The advantage for
you is that I will prioritise your issue and respond quickly. I will
be able to offer a couple of services: A ‘one-off service’ to help
with a single issue, an ‘annual maintenance service’ to help you with
multiple issues throughout the year, and possibly some form of onside
training/workshop if you desire. I am in the process of working out
the details, but please get in touch if you are interested.

If you have any questions, then let me know!

Best regards,

Vincent
